conflicts.permit: We may collect directly or through third party services: · the e-mail address of the user · the user’s personal identifier, e.g. advertising identifier, device identifier (e.g. IP address), unique device identifier (UDID), and carrier user ID · geo-location information from a GPS enabled device (if the user allowed it)
conflicts.prohibit: We does not knowingly and directly collect and store any personal information from a kid under the age of 13, and we hereby specifically prohibit children from giving us any personal information.
conflicts.situation: A child under 13 uses the game with guardian consent, and the company directly collects personal information like email or device identifiers.
conflicts.reason: The policy states kids under 13 can play with consent and that the company directly collects personal data, while flatly stating it does not directly collect personal data from kids.
